prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent interactive wedding invitation seal medallion
Primary request: Create a sculpted antique-brass wax seal or medallion matching the physical authority of the central seal in Image 1, isolated as a reusable square asset with genuine transparency.
Input images: Image 1 is a palette, relief, patina, and silhouette reference only; do not copy any lettering, layout, ribbon, paper, or surrounding interface.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background with no checkerboard, no solid color, no paper, and no environmental scene.
Subject: one directly top-down circular antique-brass wax seal with a subtly irregular hand-pressed outer edge, layered beaded inner rings, and one deeply engraved slender botanical stem with a single open flower and balanced leaves in the center.
Style/medium: photorealistic sculpted metal and wax hybrid, heirloom jewelry craftsmanship, believable hammered irregularity, aged brass patina, crisp engraved relief.
Composition/framing: square canvas; seal centered and fills about 82 percent of the frame; perfectly front-facing orthographic view; even transparent margin on all sides; clean isolated silhouette.
Lighting/mood: controlled top-left grazing studio light with deep readable relief, champagne highlights, warm bronze mids, dark brown recesses; no theatrical glow.
Color palette: antique champagne brass, warm bronze, deep brass shadow #483121, restrained near-black patina.
Materials/textures: hand-pressed irregular rim, fine scratches, oxidized recesses, crisp beading, sculpted botanical engraving that remains legible at 112 to 148 CSS pixels.
Constraints: preserve genuine alpha transparency outside the seal; no text, no letters, no numbers, no monogram, no logo, no watermark, no ribbon, no hands, no people, no extra objects.
Avoid: perfect flat coin, shiny yellow gold, modern vector icon, round button UI, fake checkerboard background, opaque square, drop-shadow halo, crown, initials, heraldry, multiple flowers, ornate clutter, CGI plastic.
